items.name: Above the Fold
items.depicts: A large framed browser window with a dark navy border, drop shadow, white active tab, blue hero rectangle above five grey text lines, and a tall beige sidebar.

items.name: Node Sapling
items.depicts: Four coloured rectangular nodes (blue root, green and orange children, purple grandchild) connected by stepped dark-grey branches.

items.name: CSS Box Model
items.depicts: Four concentric nested rectangles in orange, green, blue, and white matching the DevTools CSS box-model diagram.

items.name: Z-Index Stack
items.depicts: Three overlapping dark-bordered rectangular panes stepped diagonally forward from pale blue-grey to white.

items.name: Unclosed Tab
items.depicts: A pale grey browser tab strip with a raised white active tab containing a blue bar beside a muted grey inactive tab.

items.name: Dirty Rect
items.depicts: A dark-framed white rectangle with a bright green patch flashing in its lower-right quadrant, like a DevTools paint-flash overlay.

items.name: Third-Party Crumb
items.depicts: A round golden-ochre pixel biscuit dotted with four dark-grey square chips.

items.name: Canvas Surface
items.depicts: A dark-framed white rectangle containing a red circle overlapping a blue square.

items.name: F12 Inspector
items.depicts: A dark-slate console panel displaying three staggered horizontal timing bars in green, blue, and orange.

items.name: Floating Div
items.depicts: A tiny hollow square (blue in v0, green in v2) with a two-pixel orange tab on its upper-right corner, sitting inside a mostly empty 26x22 frame.
items.concept: floating DOM box or focus ring

items.name: Text Caret
items.depicts: A single dark-navy 1x8 vertical bar on the left side of a 26x22 transparent frame, resembling a text insertion caret.
